{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''ONE Gas Southeast Oklahoma Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pipeline-journal.net/news/one-gas-announces-major-natural-gas-pipeline-project-southeast-oklahoma|title=pipeline-journal.net|website=pipeline-journal.net|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oksenate.gov/press-releases/senator-burns-provides-update-southeastern-oklahoma-pipeline-project|title=oksenate.gov|website=oksenate.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Bennington Natural Gas Hub, Oklahoma to Hugo Plant, near Fort Towson, Oklahoma.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pipeline-journal.net/news/one-gas-announces-major-natural-gas-pipeline-project-southeast-oklahoma|title=pipeline-journal.net|website=pipeline-journal.net|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
